root_cause.detail: heartbeat_engine.py retains only MAX_RECENT_PULSE_IDS=512 and truncates recent_pulse_ids. After more than 512 accepted pulses, a previously executed pulse_id can be evicted; if that old pulse_id is replayed at a due time it is no longer recognized and can execute again. This violates the formal acceptance requirement pulse_id exactly-once/idempotent; duplicate must remain NO_OP across restart/runtime lifetime, not only within a 512-pulse window.
root_cause.test_gap: Existing duplicate test covers only an immediately retained duplicate and the 24h test covers 288 pulses, below the 512 eviction threshold.
